book.name: 1 KORIN
book.title: Tup ŋendehei ŋaiye Pol nainge nal lenge Korin

content: Ŋai ŋaiye tinge yende ofa yalme got homboꞌe

Tukwini ŋam da mininge wusyep me hroꞌ hau ŋaiye tinge yende ofa yalme got homboꞌe. Yip syeꞌ yanange nange luku poi lalme sisyeme. Kom sande tekeꞌe luku ŋende miyeꞌ gate bip ŋahraꞌe naŋ kitikin. Kut poi ya mende niharar lenge mitiŋ pe, luku ka ende sios ka tuhur bongol.
Ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka ŋoiheryembe nange kin sisyeme ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme pe, kin pupwa miyeꞌ homboꞌe, topoꞌe sande tekeꞌe kin seheiꞌe.
Kom miyeꞌ ŋaiye ŋende nihararme Got pe, sande tekeꞌe kin tatame, topoꞌe Got sisyeme kin.
Taꞌe luku pe, yuwor ŋaiye tinge yende ofa yalme got homboꞌe pe, ŋam da mininge tuꞌe leꞌe. Poi sisyeme luku: got homboꞌe yukur mise, pakai. Got mise ŋilyeh kin narp.
Ŋaiye mitiŋ syeꞌ pe, tinge yanange na, “Got wula wula sekete pe, syeꞌ yarp yanah ŋaitem, o syeꞌ yarp jah kekep.” Tinge yanange nange ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe luku got tinge, topoꞌe lahmborenge tinge.

content.text: Ŋaiye poi pe, Got sep ilyeh sai, kin Yai.
Ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme ŋaiye kin ŋende, topoꞌe poi pe, kitikin lalme.
Topoꞌe Jisas Krais kin Lahmborenge ŋilyeh.
Got topoꞌe Krais, tinge hindi yende ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe lalme leꞌe
ŋaiye tukwini sai, topoꞌe tinge pwal poi laip.

content: Kom yukur miyeꞌ tuweinge lalme sisyeme wusyep mise luku. Miyeꞌ syeꞌ yip somohon yono ŋai hroꞌ hau ŋaiye tinge yende ŋersep. Tinge sisyeme ŋaiye tinge yono ŋai ŋersep uku ŋaiye tinge yende me got homboꞌe. Taꞌe luku pe, tinge ŋoiheryembe nange tinge si yende pupwa.

Ŋai yukur ka ungwisme jahilyeh poi topoꞌe Got pe, ŋai ŋaiye poi mono, yukur ka enge poi el wohme Got. Topoꞌe ŋaiye ya mininge pakai ŋaiye yukur ya mono ŋai pe, luku yukur ka ende poi ya bwore mil ŋembep tikin Got.
Yip tatame ŋaiye pa yono ŋai ŋaiye yip yasande. Kom ŋoihme ŋaiye pa yono hroꞌ hau pe, se ka ende lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge ŋaiye jande Lahmborenge pe, yukur tinge jan bongole pe, se ka tumbe yi yoto hwap.

Nin sisyeme, ŋaiye got homboꞌe yukur sai pe, nin tatame ŋaiye na el luh moi ŋaiye tinge yende hroꞌ hau yahraꞌe naŋ tikin got homboꞌe pe, na top lenge ono ŋai. Kom ŋoihme ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende tikin Lahmborenge ŋaiye yukur gan bongole pe, ka etekeꞌe nin ŋaiye nin ŋono ŋai uku pe, luku se ka ahraꞌe ŋoihmbwaip kin ŋaiye ka ono ŋai topoꞌe. Taꞌe luku pe, kin ŋoiheryembe nange kin si ŋende hwap.
Taꞌe luku pe, ŋaiye na ono hroꞌ hau pe, ka ende yumbune toꞌ nin, kom Krais nulme kin topoꞌe.
Pe ŋaiye nin si ŋende pupwa luku no, ki ŋende yumbune ŋoiheryembe bwore tatai nin pe, luku nin si ŋende pupwa nalme Krais topoꞌe.
Taꞌe luku pe, hroꞌ hau ŋaiye kete toꞌ ŋam nato pupwa pe, yukur ma plihe mono ŋai uku no, ka ende yumbune toꞌ ŋam no, ka tumbe e oto hwap.
